value.name: Rosa's letter continues helping Lucia
value.description: The letter Rosa wrote has already done its work and still helps Lucia on bad days.
evidence: had done its work in the moment it had been written and again in the moment it had been read, and what it had asked Lucia to do, Lucia had done, and the letter was now simply a piece of paper that her mother had once held in her hands and that, on the bad days, helped.

value.name: Rosa lives in the house for nine more years
value.description: Rosa remains living in the house for another nine years after the letter's effect.
evidence: Rosa lived in the house for another nine years.

value.name: Rosa dies in her sleep
value.description: Rosa dies peacefully in the third-floor room she chose.
evidence: She died in her sleep, in the third-floor room she had chosen, on a Tuesday in October

value.name: Lucia finds Rosa dead
value.description: In the morning, Lucia discovers Rosa's body and begins calling for help.
evidence: Lucia found her in the morning and called Daniel and then called Asha

value.name: Asha arrives as a friend
value.description: Asha comes over to support Lucia and Daniel personally rather than in her professional role.
evidence: Asha came over, not as the attorney, because Rosa had a different attorney by then, a friend of Asha's whom Asha had recommended when Rosa had decided, at seventy-five, to put her own affairs in order, but as a friend

value.name: They wait in the kitchen after Rosa's death
value.description: Lucia, Daniel, and Asha sit in the kitchen drinking coffee and waiting for the authorities to arrive.
evidence: she sat in the kitchen with Lucia and Daniel and they drank coffee and waited for the people who had to come

value.name: Lucia says Rosa wanted to be there
value.description: Lucia expresses that Rosa had wanted to remain in the house until the end.
evidence: Lucia said, at one point, "She wanted to be here,"

value.name: Daniel affirms Rosa was there
value.description: Daniel responds that Rosa was indeed present in the house in the meaningful sense.

value.name: Asha reflects on the work's purpose
value.description: Asha silently realizes that preserving the house and its people was the point of her work.
evidence: Asha said nothing, because there was nothing to say
that, Asha thought, sitting in the kitchen of a house she had once helped to keep from being sold, was what the work had been for

value.name: Asha leaves the kitchen
value.description: After finishing her coffee, Asha stands up and puts her cup in the sink.
evidence: She finished her coffee. She got up. She put her cup in the sink
